close_reason: Replaced #[deprecated] with #[doc(hidden)] on three stub APIs (pkix-ac::validate_attribute_cert, pkix-ct::verify_scts, pkix-composite::CompositeVerifier::new). Added a # Limitations section to CompositeVerifier::new (the other two already had one). Removes spurious deprecation warnings while still hiding the symbol from rustdoc.
description:
Pass 2 idiom finding under epic PKIX-qwzx.

Three stub crates use `#[deprecated = \"... is not yet implemented\"]` to flag
unimplemented APIs:

- `pkix-ac/src/lib.rs:129` —
  \`#[deprecated = \"pkix-ac is not yet implemented; this function always returns AaPathInvalid\"]\`
- `pkix-ct/src/lib.rs:104` —
  \`#[deprecated = \"pkix-ct is not yet implemented; this function always returns NoTrustedSct\"]\`
- `pkix-composite/src/lib.rs:65` —
  \`#[deprecated = \"pkix-composite is not yet implemented\"]\`

`#[deprecated]` is a semver-stable contract that means **\"this item exists, works,
and is being phased out\"** — it generates a warning to migrate to a successor.
That is the wrong signal for a stub that has never worked.

Idiomatic alternatives:

1. **Best**: do not export the API yet. Mark the function as `pub(crate)` or do
   not include it in `lib.rs`. Stubs that don't compile-block downstream callers
   are not a real release contract.

2. **Acceptable**: keep the symbol but use `#[doc(hidden)]` plus a
   `# Limitations` doc section that says it's a placeholder. Combine with
   `#[allow(unused)]` on parameters.

3. **Wrong but currently used**: `#[deprecated]` — this tells `clippy` and
   `rustc` to fire migration warnings on every call site, which both confuses
   users (\"migrate to what?\") and trains them to ignore deprecation warnings.

Fix: replace `#[deprecated = \"... not yet implemented\"]` with `#[doc(hidden)]`
plus an in-doc `# Limitations` section. Keep the placeholder body.

Side effect: removes spurious deprecation warnings in downstream code that
currently calls these stubs (e.g., the workspace doc-tests in
`pkix-composite/src/lib.rs:18`).
title: (IDIOM) P3: misuse of #[deprecated] on stub APIs in pkix-ac/pkix-ct/pkix-composite
